main.description: Lists indexed work-scope tags by publisher DID with stable timestamp-and-URI ordering; authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs; repeat this key for OR matching, up to 100 values.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for timestamp-and-URI ordering; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum page size from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: WorkscopeTagQueryFailed
errors.description: The record query or publisher hydration failed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when no next page exists.
